## **Do businesses get discounted shipping rates?**


Discounted shipping rates aren’t automatic—but they’re absolutely accessible for businesses of all sizes.


Here’s how it works:


- Most businesses pay retail rates if they ship directly from UPS locations, FedEx locations, or USPS locations without a business account.
- You can get business shipping discounts from UPS and FedEx by opening a UPS account or FedEx account and scheduling packages for pickup.
- USPS discounts are available when using a postage meter or online postage tools.
- The biggest savings come from using a multi carrier shipping platform or multi carrier software that offers better-than-retail pricing and simplified management.

## **How to choose the best shipping discounts for your business**


There’s no one-size-fits-all shipping carrier when it comes to the best shipping discounts. What matters most is how well a carrier’s pricing aligns with your shipping needs. From priority mail to international shipping or standard delivery, every business is different.


Here are four key factors to consider when evaluating shipping discounts:


- **Shipping volume:** Larger shipping volumes can unlock additional savings through direct carrier pricing
- **Delivery speed:** If your customers expect express shipping, you’ll want discounts in that category.
- **Geographic coverage:** Do you focus on domestic shipping or need reliable international delivery?
- **Customer expectations:** Cost sensitivity and delivery preferences matter—so align discounts accordingly.


Instead of guessing, a tool like PitneyShip helps to simplify the process. This multi carrier shipping software platform offers:


- **Pre-negotiated USPS and UPS discounts** on certified mail, priority mail, Ground, and International services
- **Real time shipping rates** across carriers
- **No volume requirements**
- **Simplified billing** and spend tracking


Modern shipping is all about flexibility. Ditch single-carrier deals and switch to a smarter, flexible **** shipping strategy.


## **How to get UPS discounts**


You don’t need to ship hundreds of packages a day to save with UPS. Whether you're fulfilling daily orders or shipping once a week, there are smart ways to unlock UPS discounts that fit your business needs. Here are four proven strategies:


**1. Open a UPS account**


Signing up for a free UPS account gives you immediate access to built-in UPS discount rates and tools that simplify how you ship and pay.


- Save up to 50% off retail pricing
- Access pickups, billing controls, and online tools
- Pairing your account with a platforms like PitneyShip may reduce shipping surcharges and offer even more flexible billing


**2. Use multi-carrier shipping software**


Shipping software like[PitneyShip](https://www.pitneybowes.com/us/shipping-software.html) does more than print labels—it opens the door to better UPS rates and smoother operations.


- Access discounted UPS rates (up to 77% off select services)
- Compare carriers and delivery times in real time
- Simplify billing and track shipping spend in one place
- No minimum volume required


**3. Work with a fulfillment service**


If you’re scaling or want to offload logistics, a **fulfillment service** or **3PL** can offer cost savings and convenience.


- Many pass along their negotiated **UPS volume discounts**
- Gain fulfillment flexibility without managing it all in-house


**4. Negotiate directly with UPS**


For businesses with consistent shipping needs, custom rates may be available directly through a UPS rep. Just be sure to review the fine print.


- Contracts may include volume targets and service commitments
- Some perks—like guaranteed delivery refunds—may vary
- Tools like **PitneyShip** still offer great benchmarks and backup options


## **How to get USPS shipping discounts**


USPS is a low-cost shipping solution—especially when you take advantage of commercial rates. But here’s the catch: those savings aren’t available at USPS locations. If you’re buying postage at the Post Office, you’re likely overpaying—especially with 2025 rate increases.


The best USPS shipping discounts are accessed through online postage tools, shipping software, or postage meters, such as PitneyShip and PitneyShip Pro.


### **How to access USPS commercial rates**


USPS offers two tiers of commercial pricing:


- **Commercial Base Pricing (CBP)** – Available to anyone using approved online postage tools.
- **Commercial Plus Pricing (CPP)** – Available to high-volume shippers or those using qualifying shipping software.


You can access these rates through:


- Online postage vendors
- Shipping platforms like PitneyShip and PitneyShip Pro
- Approved postage meters


Eligible USPS services include:


- **Priority Mail®**
- **Priority Mail Express®**
- **First-Class Package Service®**
- **Media Mail**
- **International Mail Services**

## **How to get FedEx shipping discounts**


Looking for how to get FedEx shipping discounts that work for your business size and shipping needs? Good news: there are multiple ways to access FedEx shipping discounts, whether you ship occasionally or manage hundreds of packages a month. From account setup to partner programs and integrations with multi carrier shipping software, it’s easier than ever to unlock serious shipping discounts.


### **1. Open a FedEx account**


The first step is simple: open a FedEx account at fedex.com. This gives you access to base-level FedEx shipping discounts on services like FedEx Ground and FedEx Express, along with reduced rates on surcharges.


- No cost to set up
- Get instant access to discounted rates
- Applies to both FedEx Ground and FedEx Express services


### **2. Sign Up for the FedEx More Savings Program**


The FedEx More Savings Program offers growing discounts as your annual shipping volume increases.


- Requires use of FedEx ShipManager or another approved electronic shipping solution
- Rates improve over time based on how much you ship
- A great way to boost your FedEx discount without needing high-volume contracts


### **3. Use FedEx Advantage through partner programs**


Through the FedEx Advantage Program, you can access savings via business groups, industry associations, or partner brands like American Express and USAA®.


- No minimums or enrollment fees
- Ideal for small businesses looking to reduce FedEx discounts friction-free


### **4. Get custom quotes with the FedEx Great Rates Hotline**


For international shipping or U.S. freight over 151 lbs., the FedEx Great Rates Hotline can help you secure custom pricing.


- Call 877-463-7408 with shipment and FedEx account details
- You may qualify for a FedEx international shipping discount
- Especially helpful for large, custom, or cross-border shipments


### **5. Integrate with multi-carrier shipping software**


Connecting your FedEx account to a multi carrier shipping software or multi carrier shipping platform—like PitneyShip—unlocks even more benefits:


- Compare live rates across carriers
- Track surcharges, optimize delivery windows
- Use a modern shipping solution that improves control, efficiency, and savings
- All in one dashboard


**Bottom line:** If you're searching for how to get FedEx shipping discounts, you have flexible options—from free programs to powerful platforms. With the right tools in place, your business can save time, cut costs, and ship smarter every day.


## **How to choose the best shipping carrier for your business**


There’s no such thing as the best shipping carrier for every package. Each shipment is different—and what works for one order may not be ideal for the next. That’s why it’s smart to stay flexible and choose based on what matters most: cost, speed, and service quality.


When comparing carriers, look at more than just base rates. Review shipping options like express or economy delivery, package tracking, and support for returns. Can your customer re-route a package? Schedule a delivery time? These small details can make a big impact on customer satisfaction.


Rather than locking yourself into a single shipping carrier, businesses benefit most from working with multiple carriers. That flexibility lets you optimize each shipment for both budget and customer needs—without compromise.


The easiest way to do this? Use multi-carrier shipping software. It takes the guesswork out of carrier selection by showing you real-time pricing, delivery timelines, and service features for every shipment—so you can always choose the best option.
